PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards
